title: Night Train Radio
description: The full Mr. Sandman tune with new, original lyrics about a night train and a waking city. Four simulated singers trade the spotlight, weave close harmonies and sing playful vocal interludes.

melody.name: Bass
melody.lyrics: bim bop dum tickets Night train, hum along the railway Neon is painting all the puddles bright gold The coffee cups tap out a rhythm together While passing windows stitch the town like a sweater Night train, go chattering round bends Each little platform becomes a new friend Keep those wheels in a silver parade Night train, roll until the morning Night train, slip beside the river Radios whistle a bright tune in the aisle Bakers tie aprons at the edge of the doorway Two sleepy cats watch as the red sparks drift away Night train, with buttons made of brass Polish the moon as the last houses pass All the shoes start a soft serenade Night train, roll until the morning Night train, postcards for the seaside The coats have a pocket of sand and a map Warm paper lanterns are bobbing above us Now grandpa is dancing with tickets for two Night train, your wheels of blue and gold Blue and gold Carry this laughter where stories unfold Let those windows glow marmalade Night train, the city's waking Choo, choo, choo Night train, roll on to the shoreline
melody.source: Mr. Sandman tune — Pat Ballard. New original words; vocal adaptation using F. Montero’s musical-note reference.
